description: Find a person's professional profile by name (+company) via Coresignal — returns title, current company, location, LinkedIn URL, work experience and education. LinkedIn-adjacent people data. Example: coresignal_employee({ name: "Patrick Collison", company: "Stripe", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Coresignal API key (BYO). Sign up + start a trial at coresignal.com.

company.description: Optional company name to disambiguate, e.g. "Stripe".

name.description: Full name of the person, e.g. "Patrick Collison".

name: coresignal_employee
